overview.description: The repository is an object-mapping library organized around a core engine for configuration/projection, mapper API behavior, attribute mapping/DI, and proxy generation internals; a small licensing product-type subsystem supplies a domain abstraction used by licensing code. The benchmark timer and TestApp assembly are auxiliary infrastructure, while the test project contains assertion helpers and type-extension tests that validate mapping behavior. A large cluster of one-file runtime entity and DTO fixtures exercises the runtime mapping path in the MapAtRuntime regression scenario, with each separate fixture providing a distinct source or destination shape. A parallel MapAtRuntimeWithCollections cluster repeats that pattern for collection mapping, using base entity/DTO classes to verify inherited collection members are handled. Together, these fixtures are consumed by the surrounding test harness to reproduce and verify runtime mapping behavior against the core engine.
